prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Two Column Split Redesign: Rebuild the adoption certificate layout into a side-by-side split layout showing companion traits on one side and registration details on the other.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Your new companion is officially registered to your desktop habitat.", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
1: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Habitat Sound & Activity Timer Layout: Add ambient habitat sound indicators and visual progress tracking to the waiting screen while pet generation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "sound", "text": "Ambient Habitat Audio", "style": "calm"}, {"type": "animation", "text": "Pet hatching animation", "style": "playful"}]}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Quick Command Cheat Sheet Screen: Add a dedicated quick command cheat sheet screen at the end of onboarding that highlights hotkeys for controlling, talking to, and hiding the pet.
   config: {"new_command_cheatsheet": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Quick Companion Desktop Commands", "body": "Learn how to summon, feed, or hide your companion anytime using simple desktop hotkeys.", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Press Alt+P to toggle desktop visibility", "style": "highlight"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_command_cheatsheet"]}
3: [home, new_flow] Desktop Habitat Preparation Interactive Preview Flow: Introduce a interactive preview flow on the waiting screen enabling users to explore desktop habitat sounds and themes while pet generation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Preparing Your Pet Desktop Habitat", "body": "Preview desktop habitat sounds and themes while your custom pet finishes generating.", "components": [{"type": "preview", "text": "Desktop Habitat Live Preview", "style": "rounded"}]}}
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Ambient Audio Activity Hint: Display an ambient audio hint on the waiting screen reassuring users that pet rendering is actively working in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "Listen closely to hear your pet getting ready in its background desktop habitat!", "show_progress": true}}
5: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Full Bleed Gallery Redesign: Redesign the companion selection step into a full bleed gallery layout showcasing high-resolution pet animations.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Choose Your Perfect Desktop Companion", "components": [{"type": "preview", "text": "Full size companion visual presentation", "style": "large"}]}}
6: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Desktop Placement Reassurance Hint: Add an explicit hint on the adoption certificate reassuring users that their pet will automatically appear on their desktop taskbar once ready.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"hint": "Your companion will appear directly on your desktop taskbar once setup is complete."}}
7: [finish, copy] Home Intro Desktop Controls Quick Reference Copy: Update headline and body on the final home intro screen to explain how to summon, control, and hide the pet on the desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Welcome Your Companion to Your Desktop", "body": "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, access settings, or start a voice interaction."}}
8: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Completion Notification Toggle: Enable an explicit desktop notification prompt on the pet generation waiting screen so users know when generation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Pet Generation in Progress", "body": "We will send a desktop notification as soon as your companion is ready to meet you."}}
9: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Card Carousel Layout: Switch the story screen layout to a card carousel presentation to engage users before path selection.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Welcome to Desktop Pets", "body": "Swipe to explore how your desktop pet lives and interacts with your workspace."}}
